title: 12 Best Rooftop Bars in Almaty
description: Discover Almaty's top rooftop bars for stunning city views, delicious cocktails, and vibrant atmospheres. From luxury lounges to cozy terraces, find your perfect elevated escape.

places.name: LT Bar & Grill (The Ritz-Carlton, Almaty)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic Old Fashioned from their extensive whiskey collection, paired with Wagyu Beef Sliders.

places.name: Vista Restaurant & Bar (Hotel Kazakhstan)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their signature 'Vista Cocktail' and a traditional Kazakh dish like Beshbarmak to enjoy the local flavor with the view.

places.name: SIX Panoramic Bar & Restaurant (Novotel Living Almaty Jetisu)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'SIX Sunset' cocktail and the Truffle Pasta. Excellent for sharing plates.

places.name: Barfly (InterContinental Almaty)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore their whiskey menu, perhaps a premium Japanese whiskey, accompanied by their gourmet cheese platter.

places.name: SKY Rooftop Bar (Ramada by Wyndham Almaty)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic Mojito or their local beer selection, with a plate of their crispy calamari.

places.name: The Roof Bar (Sheraton Palace Hotel Almaty)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Sheraton Spritz' and grilled skewers from the barbecue menu (seasonal).

places.name: S.N.U.F.F. Restaurant & Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order One of their creative fruit-infused hookahs and a refreshing 'Lychee Martini'.

places.name: Restaurant-Bar 19 (Rixos Almaty)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their Azerbaijani Plov with lamb and a glass of fine Georgian wine.

places.name: Sky Lobby Bar (Hilton Garden Inn Almaty)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their classic cheeseburger and a local draft beer, or a freshly brewed espresso.

places.name: Kok Tobe Restaurant & Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Order a local wine or vodka, and definitely try the Kazy (horse sausage) or a hearty Laghman.

places.name: Barstol & Kitchen
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their 'Barstol Signature' cocktail and the Beef Medallions with truffle sauce.

places.name: Urban Terrace (Dostyk Hotel)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A cold local beer like Zatecky Gus or a refreshing non-alcoholic mocktail, paired with their crispy Spring Rolls.
